manifest.name: Alert
manifest.description: A takeover for emergencies and notices: the severity in a band, a headline, what to do, who issued it, when it ends and a QR code for updates.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.default: Use the nearest stairway. Do not use the elevators. Gather at the north car park and wait for your floor warden.

manifest.name: Announcement
manifest.description: Company news: a headline and body, a photo, up to three facts and a QR code, in four looks.

body.label: Body
body.default: Come for coffee, a tour and the first look at the roof terrace.

manifest.name: Clock
manifest.description: Large live clock and date with a greeting. Good as a welcome screen or a break between ads.

manifest.name: Countdown
manifest.description: The days to go to a date and time, or the days since one (a safety record), in four looks.

target.label: Counts down to, or up from

recordDays.label: Record in days, counting up (0 for none)

progressDays.label: Show the progress over the last days, counting down

manifest.name: C-Store Promo
manifest.description: Multi-buy price promotion with three product shots and a loyalty points badge.

manifest.name: Agenda
manifest.description: Upcoming events from a calendar. Bind the events field to an iCal data source (Google Calendar, Outlook, and others).

rows.label: Most events to show (as many as fit, up to this)

empty.label: Shown when there is nothing coming up

manifest.name: Info frame
manifest.description: A main photo with a caption, framed by a clock, the weather with a three-day forecast, the logo and a news crawl. Bind the weather to a place and the crawl to an RSS feed; the rail and the crawl go where you put them, and each part can be switched off.

day1Time.label: Day 1 Unix time (0: from screen clock)

day2Time.label: Day 2 Unix time (0: from screen clock)

day3Time.label: Day 3 Unix time (0: from screen clock)

manifest.name: Menu Board
manifest.description: A priced list in one or two columns with optional tags. For menus, service lists and price lists.

manifest.name: News
manifest.description: The top story large, the next few below, and every headline in a crawl along the bottom. Bind items to an RSS data source.

manifest.name: Photo Promo
manifest.description: Full-screen photograph with a slow push-in, a headline and a price tag.

manifest.name: Room status
manifest.description: Whether a meeting room or class is free or busy now, until when, and the rest of its day. Bind the events field to the room's iCal calendar.

manifest.name: Weather Now
manifest.description: Current conditions with today's high and low. Bind the numeric fields to a weather data source. Bind sunrise and sunset too, and the sun and moon cross the sky with the screen's clock.

data.headline: Evacuate the building now

data.headline: Pier 9 opens on Monday

info-frame.name: Info frame, 4K photo, live weather and news

events.title: Quarterly planning with the regional team

data.headline: Go further
data.body: Trail snacks and cold drinks, ready to go
